description: Org-wide rules (schedule, grouping, automerge, the .tekton re-synth) live in renovate/tektonic-ci.json, shared with the provider repos. Only what is specific to core stays here. Presets are read from main, so a change to the shared file takes effect once merged, not on its PR.

Image pins live in TypeScript; .tekton/ is synthesized from it. Renovate only ever saw the output — the Ansible manager matches any tasks/*.yaml, so .tekton/tasks/*.k8s.yaml was rewritten by accident of the path while the source that generates it stayed behind, and the next `tektonic synth` would have reverted the bump. The shared preset switches that manager off.
This manager puts the pins themselves under Renovate; the shared postUpgradeTasks re-synthesize the manifests that follow from them, so both sides of a bump land on one branch.
config:recommended ignores examples/ by default, which is why ignorePaths is spelled out here without it.
Add a file when it grows a versioned image literal. Unversioned tags (base:stable) are left alone by the leading digit required of currentValue.
